lessons.title: An t-uatha: an fhréamh
lessons.rule: To tell one person to do something, use the root of the verb on its own, with nothing added: Suigh síos. Druid an doras. Éist. The root is the form a dictionary gives, and every tense is built from it.
steps: Find the verb: an doras a dhruidim.
Use the root on its own: druid, éist, ceannaigh.
Add the rest of the sentence: Druid an doras.

example.prompt: An dtig leat an doras a dhruidim?

lessons.hint: One person: the root, with nothing added.

items.prompt: An dtig leat an fhuinneog a oscailt?
An dtig leat an solas a lasadh?
An dtig leat an clár bán a ghlanadh?
An dtig leat do chóipleabhar a thógáil amach?
An dtig leat an t-urlár a scuabadh?
An dtig leat na leabhair a bhailiú?
An dtig leat an lón a ullmhú?
An dtig leat an solas a mhúchadh?

lessons.title: An t-iolra: -aigí agus -igí
lessons.rule: To tell more than one person, add an ending to the root. One-syllable verbs take -aigí after a broad vowel and -igí after a slender one: glanaigí, tógaigí, éistigí, druidigí. Verbs in -aigh or -igh drop it and take -aígí or -ígí: ceannaígí, bailígí. Suigh, nigh and léigh give suígí, nígí and léigí. Verbs that shorten do the same: osclaígí, imrígí.
steps: Is the last vowel of the root broad (a, o, u) or slender (i, e)?

items.prompt: (Oscail: sibh) bhur leabhair ar leathanach a deich.
items.answer: Osclaígí bhur leabhair ar leathanach a deich.

lessons.title: Ná: an t-ordú diúltach
lessons.en: Don't: Ná, and h before a vowel
lessons.rule: To tell someone not to do something, put Ná before the command. Ná does not change a consonant: Ná bris é. Ná druidigí an doras. Before a vowel, Ná adds h: Ná hól é. Ná hith é. Ná héistigí leis.
steps: Write the command: bris, ól, éistigí.
Does the verb begin with a vowel? Add h: Ná hól.

items.prompt: Fág do mhála ar an urlár.
items.answer: Ná fág do mhála ar an urlár.
Ná hith an císte ar fad.
Ná druid an doras go fóill.

items.prompt: Buailigí an liathróid in éadan an bhalla.
items.answer: Ná buailigí an liathróid in éadan an bhalla.
Ná caith bruscar ar an talamh.

lessons.title: Déanaimis nó Déanadh muid
lessons.rule: For let's, add -aimis to a broad root or -imis to a slender one: déanaimis, fanaimis, cuirimis. Verbs in -aigh or -igh, and verbs that shorten, take -aímis or -ímis: ceannaímis, tosaímis, imrímis. You will also hear the form with muid: déanadh muid, cuireadh muid, imríodh muid. Both are right. For let's not, put Ná in front: Ná déanaimis.
steps: Or use -adh or -eadh with muid: déanadh muid.

example.prompt: (Déan: muid) an obair bhaile le chéile.
example.answer: Déanaimis an obair bhaile le chéile. / Déanadh muid an obair bhaile le chéile.

more.answer: Imrímis cluiche eile. / Imríodh muid cluiche eile.

items.prompt: (Éist: muid) leis an amhrán sin arís.
items.answer: Éistimis leis an amhrán sin arís.
items.alt: Éisteadh muid leis an amhrán sin arís.
Siúladh muid go dtí an siopa.

lessons.title: Na briathra neamhrialta
lessons.rule: Irregular verbs use their root as a command too: Bí, Déan, Ith, Faigh, Abair, Tabhair, Beir, Tar, Téigh. In Ulster, Gabh is often used for go: Gabh abhaile. The plurals are Bígí, Déanaigí, Ithigí, Faighigí, Abraigí, Tugaigí, Beirigí, Tagaigí, Téigí and Gabhaigí. For look, say Amharc; Feic and Cluin are rare as commands (say Éist for listen). Ná works as usual: Ná habair é, Ná tar isteach.
steps: Take the root: tar, abair, tabhair.
More than one person: learn the plural (tagaigí, abraigí, tugaigí).
Not: Ná, with h before a vowel (Ná habair).
lessons.hint: Tar: tagaigí. Abair: abraigí. Tabhair: tugaigí.

lessons.title: Sa seomra ranga
lessons.rule: A teacher usually speaks to the whole class, so most classroom commands are plural: Seasaigí suas. Suígí síos. Osclaígí bhur leabhair. Change do (your, one person) to bhur (your, more than one), and make the noun plural. Bhur eclipses: bhur gcóipleabhair, bhur bpinn.
steps: Make the verb plural: suigh becomes suígí.
Make the noun plural and eclipse it after bhur: do chóipleabhar becomes bhur gcóipleabhair.
lessons.hint: Plural verb; do becomes bhur, and bhur eclipses.

items.prompt: Déan an cleachtadh ar leathanach a cúig.
items.answer: Déanaigí an cleachtadh ar leathanach a cúig.
